_doc: Backgrounds (Backgrounds.gd): who you were before the Guild, chosen at character creation. Light, flavourful effects: attributes (once, at creation), start_copper (+/-), start_items [{id, qty}], sell_bonus (share added to sell prices), craft_discount {blacksmith, enchanter}, rapport_traits {trait: starting rapport with adventurers who have it}, reputation {archetype: points toward how the Guild sees you}, training_points (armour training), legend (how your Legend remembers your youth).

orphan.name: Orphan
orphan.description: Raised by the streets of {birthplace}. You learned to be quick, and to trust slowly.

merchants_child.name: Merchant's Child
merchants_child.description: You grew up behind a counter, haggling before you could walk.

bandit.name: Former Bandit
bandit.description: You ran with a gang on the roads out of {birthplace}. You left - mostly.
bandit.legend: a bandit who turned to honest work

vagabond.name: Vagabond
vagabond.description: No town held you for long. You know every road on Nyxarys - and how to sleep on it.
vagabond.legend: a wanderer with no fixed home

bakers_child.name: Baker's Child
bakers_child.description: Up before dawn at the ovens of {birthplace}. You still smell of bread when you're nervous.

blacksmiths_child.name: Blacksmith's Child
blacksmiths_child.description: You worked the bellows in {birthplace} and know good steel when you see it.

temple_foundling.name: Temple Foundling
temple_foundling.description: Left on a temple's steps and raised by its priests.
temple_foundling.legend: a foundling raised by the temple

scholars_apprentice.name: Scholar's Apprentice
scholars_apprentice.description: You copied old texts until your hands cramped - and some of it stuck.

farmhand.name: Farmhand
farmhand.description: Fields, fences and long days outside {birthplace}. Nothing scares you like a bad harvest.

nobles_bastard.name: Noble's Bastard
nobles_bastard.description: A great house's name you can't use, and a purse to make up for it.
nobles_bastard.legend: the unclaimed child of a noble house

soldiers_child.name: Soldier's Child
soldiers_child.description: Raised in a garrison. You marched before you could read.

hunters_child.name: Hunter's Child
hunters_child.description: Tracks, snares and long silences in the woods near {birthplace}.
